cues.text: Night, under a huge green moon. On a rooftop, Yukari looks back.
The moon shines in an eye.
The roof's edge lies still.
A black hand reaches over the edge.
More hands rise along the edge.
One hand lifts a blue mask with a sad face.
Against the moon, long black arms hold the mask high.
Other hands raise swords.
The arms crawl across the roof.
Yukari draws a pistol from her thigh holster.
She lifts it toward her head, "S.E.E.S." engraved on its side. Her eyes squeeze shut.
A black hand swats her. She falls hard, and the gun skids away.
The masked creature looms over the hero, swords raised.
A huge black hand lands beside Yukari.
The hero looks on, calm.
A room full of monitors.
Mitsuru, Akihiko and Ikutsuki watch.
On a screen, the hero stands by a brick wall.
The gun lies on the tiles, near Yukari.
A flash: a small boy in stripes.
The hero picks up the gun.
His eye, close. Streaks of blue light rush into it.
White light. The striped boy looks on.
The hero raises the gun to his temple.
He closes his eye, and smiles.
Blue light. His eyes glow. Shards of light whirl around him.
A pillar of light bursts up from him.
Orpheus, a pale figure built around a lyre, hovers above the hero.
Its red eye glows under white hair.
Yukari lifts her head from the ground.
The hero stands with the gun, Orpheus behind him.
Suddenly he doubles over, clutching his head.
Ikutsuki frowns, worried.
Orpheus grabs its own head and bends double.
Red light tears out of Orpheus's head. Hands rip it open from inside.
A black-coated figure bursts out, with a white, fanged mask.
Coffins hang from chains around it, fanned out like wings.
Mitsuru and Akihiko stare. Ikutsuki gapes.
The masked Shadow raises its swords.
The figure cocks its head.
Its coffins spread behind it as it lunges.
It seizes the Shadow's arms and tears through them.
A streak of light slices the blue mask in two.
Severed arms twitch on the ground. Yukari watches.
The Shadow melts into black sludge.
Against the moon, the figure grips a torn black arm and squeezes. Dark blood sprays.
Yukari stares, teeth clenched.
The glow fades from the hero's eyes.
The figure fades back into Orpheus.
Orpheus floats before the great moon. The picture fades.
